description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMappingProcessor' which provides a template for processing message mappings from an input type to an output type, including condition resolution and error handling. It is part of the messaging connectivity services in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractMappingProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing the foundational structure for processing message mappings, including condition resolution and error handling, to be extended for specific mapping implementations.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Abstract method to process an incoming message of type I and produce a list of MappingOutcome of type O.

methods.name: resolveConditions
methods.description: Resolves a collection of string conditions using a provided ExpressionResolver, evaluating each to a boolean and returning the combined result.

methods.name: buildMappingFailedException
methods.description: Constructs a MessageMappingFailedException with details about the failure, including direction, content type, mapper ID, headers, and the underlying cause.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MessageMapper instances for a given PayloadMapping; falls back to a default mapper if none are found.
